chars.MALIK: MALIK: a slim Moroccan man in his mid-twenties with short black hair and a short beard, wearing a faded mustard-yellow hoodie and grey jogging pants
chars.DIRECTOR: DIRECTOR: a heavy Moroccan prison director in his fifties with a thick grey moustache, wearing a dark navy officer uniform with gold epaulettes and a peaked cap
chars.GUARD: GUARD: a Moroccan prison guard wearing a light blue shirt with dark blue trousers and a black belt with keys
chars.POLICE: POLICE: three Moroccan plainclothes police investigators in dark leather jackets, one bald with glasses

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan prison courtyard in the morning, the stern DIRECTOR and a GUARD march straight toward MALIK, who freezes mid-exercise, shocked; the director points at him angrily; other prisoners in the background stop and stare

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Inside a crowded Moroccan prison cell, several prisoners whisper to each other and look suspiciously at MALIK sitting on a bunk bed, gossip spreading, tense mood

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: At the barred door of a Moroccan prison cell, the GUARD leans in and tells MALIK something serious, MALIK stands up worried, face tense

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: The GUARD escorts MALIK down a long dim prison corridor with metal doors, MALIK looks anxious and afraid, cold fluorescent light

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: The GUARD opens a heavy iron door to a small office room and pushes MALIK inside, MALIK hesitates at the threshold, scared

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In a bare small interrogation room with one table, three POLICE investigators stand waiting with crossed arms and cold stares as MALIK enters, intimidating

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: A POLICE investigator slams a folded handwritten paper letter on the table in front of MALIK sitting on a chair, the other investigator leans over him menacingly

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Close view: MALIK sits silent and frozen at the interrogation table, sweating, eyes wide, while a POLICE investigator stares at him waiting for an answer, the letter between them
